notes.text: Hyman’s Hebrew tractate label reads ניטין. The linked Gemara and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2959&lang=en) give Rabbi Pinchas ben Aruva speaking about the death of Titus.
Aruva is a conventional vocalization of ערובא. The notice gives the parent-name heading, the named Pinchas ben Aruva and a citation; no further biography is supplied.
